summary: This re-adoption of PR #58 adds a real Work Progress Report feature (scope/category/manpower/vendor breakdowns computed from VERIDIAN BoQ+progress+attendance data) plus a new PROJEXA-owned photo-attachment table/storage bucket; the diff correctly triggers tier2 via drizzle/schema/RLS changes and does not touch .github/workflows/**. Architecture follows established repo conventions closely (callVeridian path/root usage matches existing /attendance, /vendors, /construction/labour-roster routes exactly; the photo upload route uses the user's own RLS-scoped Supabase session rather than a service-role bypass, consistent with org/provision/route.ts's pattern; profiles.id vs auth.users(id) FK targeting matches the codebase's existing dual-reference convention). The Prev/Current/Total math and date-boundary handling are covered by real, meaningful unit tests plus a genuine offline-queue-to-report integration test, and the migration's non-live-applied status is honestly disclosed (same documented constraint as drizzle/0011). A few non-blocking gaps worth a human's attention before/at merge: the photo POST route trusts a client-supplied veridianEntryId with no server-side check that it belongs to the caller's org/project (integrity is app-layer only by design, but unvalidated); there is no file size/type limit on photo upload (matches this repo's pre-existing permits/drawings/documents upload routes, so not a new regression); and the BoQ selection `boqs.find(b => b.status !== 'superseded') ?? boqs[0]` picks the first non-superseded entry in API response order rather than an explicitly-sorted latest revision, which could silently pick the wrong BoQ if VERIDIAN ever returns multiple concurrent active revisions unsorted. The feature is also functionally dependent on a companion compliance-tracker PR (#608) enriching /scope and /work-progress/activities with lineItems/categories; this PR degrades gracefully (empty report) if that companion PR isn't merged, but full functionality requires both.
issues: Photo upload route (src/app/api/work-progress/photos/route.ts POST) accepts a client-supplied veridianEntryId with no verification it corresponds to a real entry in the caller's org/project -- integrity for that cross-database reference is app-layer only per design, but currently unenforced even at that layer.

No file size or content-type allow-list on photo upload -- consistent with this repo's existing permits/drawings/documents upload routes (not a new regression) but still an open gap for storage-cost abuse.

src/app/api/work-progress/report/route.ts:54 selects the 'latest' BoQ via `boqs.find(b => b.status !== 'superseded') ?? boqs[0]`, which picks the first non-superseded entry in whatever order the API returns rather than an explicitly version/date-sorted latest revision; could silently compute the report against the wrong BoQ if multiple active revisions are ever returned unsorted.

Full report functionality depends on a companion compliance-tracker PR (#608) that enriches VERIDIAN's /scope and /work-progress/activities responses with lineItems/categories; without it merged, this PR's report renders empty rather than erroring (safe default) but the feature isn't complete until both PRs land.
